title: Claude Cowork: Top 5 Tips for Productivity
description:
✅ Grab The Claude Cowork Stack - https://clickhubspot.com/3ed95e

#Claude #Cowork is insanely powerful, but there's no "gold standard" yet for setting it up, so most people get the foundation wrong and watch their workspace silently degrade over time.

After 3 months running my entire business on Cowork, this video walks you through the 5 essential rules I wish I'd known from day one. You'll learn how to keep your root CLAUDE.md lean, give your MEMORY.md the right structure, archive what's no longer current, migrate Claude Projects into Cowork workstations, and understand when to use a skill versus a workstation.
